name: dev.ucp.shopping.offer
title: Offer Extension
description: Extends Cart with Business-proposed Cart transitions. An Offer states: given this exact Cart state, the Business proposes this resulting Cart state. Each Offer is bound to the Cart state it was generated against, so a proposal cannot be silently applied to a Cart that has since changed. An outstanding (not-yet-applied) Offer is represented as an outstanding Action of type `dev.ucp.shopping.offer` (see Overview — Actions); applied-Offer provenance is separate extension-owned Cart state, not an Action.

applies_to.description: The exact Cart state this Offer was generated against.

cart_id.description: Identifier of the Cart this Offer applies to. MUST match the Cart carrying the Offer.

state_ref.description: Opaque, implementation-assigned reference to the exact Cart state this Offer was generated against. Not interpreted by the Platform. The Business MUST determine whether the source state still matches using exact token-value equality between this value and its current state reference for the Cart. Implementations MUST NOT parse, normalize, canonicalize, or semantically compare state_ref values. The Business MUST reject a new application attempt when the Cart no longer matches this state, even if the Offer has not expired.

proposed_update.description: The Cart state the Business proposes. Uses existing Cart update semantics; this extension defines no separate mutation vocabulary.

line_items.description: Proposed target line items, using the same full-replacement semantics as a Cart update. Represents the complete resulting line-item state, not a delta.

impact.description: Structured preview of what applying this Offer would change, for agent evaluation. The Cart returned after application remains authoritative.

total_delta.description: Change to the Cart grand total if this Offer is applied, in the Cart currency's ISO 4217 minor units. Positive when the total increases, negative when it decreases.

presentation.description: Non-authoritative display copy. Not decision-relevant: changing it does not change what the Offer proposes.

title.description: Short human-readable Offer title (e.g., 'Add a travel charger').

offer_action_config.description: Protocol identity and proposal data for one outstanding dev.ucp.shopping.offer Action instance. The Action's own `id` identifies this outstanding occurrence per the common Actions contract; it is distinct from the Business-assigned Offer `id`+`revision` carried here, which identifies the immutable proposal artifact itself.

offer_id.description: Business-assigned Offer identifier, stable across revisions. Distinct from the Action instance's own `id`.

revision.description: Business-assigned revision of this Offer. Together with `offer_id` this forms the operational identity of an immutable Offer artifact: any change to decision-relevant terms MUST be issued as a new revision, and a new revision MUST be surfaced as a new Action instance with a new Action `id` (the prior instance's work is no longer outstanding).

expires_at.description: Offer expiry timestamp (RFC 3339). Expiry invalidates the Offer independently of source-state staleness.

applied_offer.description: Provenance for an Offer that was applied to this Cart, recording which exact Offer revision caused the transition. Applied-Offer provenance is not outstanding work and MUST NOT be represented as an Action.

affected_line_item_ids.description: Identifiers of the Cart line items this Offer created or changed.

offers_object.description: Offers already applied to this Cart. Outstanding (available) Offers are represented as dev.ucp.shopping.offer Actions in the Cart's `actions` map, not here.

applied.description: Offers already applied to this Cart, most recent last.

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Offers
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended with Offer capability. Declares the dev.ucp.shopping.offer Action type for outstanding (available) Offer proposals, and adds `offers.applied` for applied-Offer provenance.

dev.ucp.shopping.offer.description: Outstanding Offer proposals against the current Cart state. Applying one changes the Cart state and makes sibling instances bound to the previous state stale; the Business MUST then omit them from the next response. An outstanding Offer Action MUST NOT gate or block any unrelated Cart operation.

id.description: Identifier of this outstanding Action occurrence. Stable while this exact proposal remains outstanding; a replacement proposal (new revision, or a new proposal against a new Cart state) MUST use a new Action id.
